invariants.rationale: FileHandle file is expected to be non-null to perform a successful load.
fileName should be a non-null, non-empty string to identify the file to load.
AssetManager manager must be non-null as it is required for asset loading operations.
If parameter is not null, its texture filter fields should also be non-null for setTextureFilters.
The referenced FileHandle should point to an existing file for loading.
